announcements.title: Mid-Semester Examination Schedule Released
announcements.content: The mid-semester examination schedule for all branches has been released. Examinations will commence from 17th June 2026. Students are advised to check the detailed timetable on the notice board and collect their admit cards from the Academic Section (Admin Block, Ground Floor) between 12th June and 16th June 2026 during working hours. No student will be permitted to appear in the examination without a valid admit card.

announcements.title: Attendance Shortage Warning – Action Required
announcements.content: As per the attendance records updated up to 8th June 2026, a number of students across all branches have fallen below the 75% attendance threshold required for eligibility to appear in the mid-semester examinations. Such students are advised to meet their respective Branch Coordinators immediately for a condonation application. The last date to submit condonation requests is 13th June 2026. Failure to do so will result in automatic debarment from the mid-semester examinations.

announcements.title: DSA Lab Assignment – Submission Deadline Extended
announcements.content: Due to the upcoming mid-semester examinations, the submission deadline for the Data Structures & Algorithms (CS301) Lab Assignment No. 4 on Binary Trees has been extended to 18th June 2026. Students must submit both the hard copy report and the source code via the department portal. Late submissions will attract a 10% penalty per day. For queries, contact Dr. Rajeev Mohan Srivastava at rms@ece.ac.in.

announcements.title: Guest Lecture on Power Grid Modernisation – 14th June 2026
announcements.content: The Department of Electrical Engineering is pleased to announce a guest lecture by Er. Harshvardhan Mehta, Senior Executive Engineer, UP Power Transmission Corporation Ltd., on the topic 'Smart Grid Technologies and the Future of Power Distribution in India'. The lecture will be held on 14th June 2026 (Sunday) at 10:30 AM in Seminar Hall SH-01. Attendance is open to all students and faculty. B.Tech. EE students will receive internal marks credit for attendance.

announcements.title: Industrial Visit – Tata Chemicals Ltd., Babrala – Registration Open
announcements.content: The Department of Chemical Engineering is organising an industrial visit to Tata Chemicals Ltd., Babrala, Uttar Pradesh, on 5th July 2026. The visit is open to 3rd-year Chemical Engineering students. Students interested in participating must register by submitting the duly filled consent form along with a fee of ₹350 at the department office by 20th June 2026. Only the first 40 applicants will be accommodated. Transportation and lunch will be provided.

announcements.title: CAD Software Workshop – SolidWorks & AutoCAD
announcements.content: The Department of Mechanical Engineering, in association with the Training & Placement Cell, is conducting a two-day hands-on workshop on SolidWorks 2025 and AutoCAD 2026 for B.Tech. Mechanical Engineering students. The workshop will be held on 21st and 22nd June 2026 in CAD Lab CAD-01. Participants must register by 15th June 2026 at the Mechanical Engineering Department office. Registration fee: ₹200 (refundable on 90% workshop attendance). Certificate of participation will be issued.

announcements.title: Library Closure During Mid-Semester Examinations
announcements.content: The Central Library will observe extended working hours (8:00 AM to 10:00 PM) from 14th June to 1st July 2026 to support students during the mid-semester examination period. However, the library will remain closed on 20th June 2026 (Saturday) on account of a scheduled maintenance shutdown. Students are requested to plan their study schedules accordingly. Overdue fines will continue to accrue during this period.

announcements.title: National Level Technical Paper Presentation – Submissions Invited
announcements.content: TECHNOVA 2026, the annual national-level technical paper presentation competition organised by the Student Technical Council, will be held on 12th–13th September 2026. Students from all branches are invited to submit abstracts (300–500 words) by 15th July 2026 via the official portal at technova.institute.ac.in. Selected teams will be notified by 1st August 2026. Best paper awards carry a cash prize of ₹15,000. Teams may consist of 2–4 members.

announcements.title: Revised Academic Calendar – Compensatory Classes
announcements.content: Due to the two unscheduled holidays observed on 9th April and 2nd May 2026, the Academic Section has revised the class schedule for the current semester. Compensatory classes for the affected batches will be held on the following Saturdays: 20th June, 4th July, and 18th July 2026 from 8:00 AM to 1:00 PM. The detailed compensatory timetable for each branch is available on the institute notice board and the student ERP portal.

announcements.title: Civil Engineering Soil Testing Field Trip – Notification
announcements.content: As a part of the Geotechnical Engineering (CE302) course curriculum, a mandatory field visit to the Institute Soil Testing Laboratory and the Yamuna Riverbed sampling site near Bijnor has been scheduled for 28th June 2026. All 3rd-year Civil Engineering students must attend. Departure will be at 7:00 AM from the main gate. Students must bring their laboratory journals and wear institute-issued PPE. Last date to submit the consent and indemnity form: 18th June 2026.

announcements.title: Anti-Ragging Compliance – Affidavit Submission Reminder
announcements.content: As mandated by the Hon'ble Supreme Court of India and UGC regulations, all students are required to submit a signed anti-ragging affidavit for the current academic year. Students who have not yet submitted the affidavit are directed to do so at the Administrative Section, 1st Floor, Admin Block, on any working day before 20th June 2026. Non-compliance will lead to disciplinary action as per the institute's Anti-Ragging Policy.

announcements.title: Theory of Computation – Additional Study Material Uploaded
announcements.content: Additional reference notes and solved previous-year question papers for Theory of Computation (CS306) covering Regular Languages, Context-Free Grammars, and Turing Machines have been uploaded to the course page on the student portal. Students are strongly advised to go through this material before the mid-semester examination. For doubts, contact Dr. Pradeep Nair during office hours (Tuesday & Thursday, 1:00 PM – 2:00 PM, Room 309).

announcements.title: Electromagnetic Field Theory – Course Correction Notice
announcements.content: Students of Electronics & Communication Engineering are informed that the topic 'Wave Propagation in Lossy Dielectrics' (Unit IV, EC303) has been rescheduled and will now be covered after the mid-semester examinations. The mid-semester question paper will therefore be limited to Units I, II, and III only. The updated course plan has been shared by Prof. Girish Chandra Mishra via the ERP portal.

announcements.title: Training & Placement Cell – Pre-Placement Orientation
announcements.content: The Training & Placement Cell will conduct a pre-placement orientation session for all final and pre-final year students on 16th June 2026 at 3:00 PM in the Main Auditorium. The session will cover resume building, aptitude test preparation, and interview etiquette. Attendance is mandatory for all students registered with the placement cell. Students who have not yet registered are requested to do so at tpc@institute.ac.in before 14th June 2026.
